name: Chimp Chase Reborn
summary: Chimp Chase Reborn is a rebirth of the original game "Chimp Chase 2". It was recently rebirthed by GetaGames Limited and brought back! Chimp Chase Reborn uses the Gorilla Locomotion made by AnotherAxiom. In Chimp Chase Reborn, you can explore the wilderness of Chimp Chase Reborn, exploring the forest map, the caves map, or even if you want a scary and thrilling experience, explore the mines! We hope you enjoy your stay here at Chimp Chase Reborn!
